title: Weighted volume monotonicity and isoperimetric comparison under a lower Ricci curvature bound
summary: We establish a weighted extension of the Bishop-Gromov volume comparison theorem for complete Riemannian manifolds with Ricci curvature bounded below. Given a point $p$ and positive radial weights $f$ and $h$, we consider the weighted volume of a geodesic ball and a corresponding model weighted volume in the simply connected space form of constant sectional curvature $k$. We prove that, under the assumption that $h/f$ is nondecreasing, the ratio of these two weighted volumes is nonincreasing with respect to the radius.
